sculpture.name: Keepsake
sculpture.help: Place it, then leave logs nearby. Twelve wood make a shared reminder.

bath.name: Rain shower
bath.help: A little privacy. Cleans one creature at a time.

orchard.name: Banana grove
orchard.help: Grows a small, replenishing supply of bananas.

mine.name: Mine
mine.help: Place on a stone deposit. Workers extract ore.

dwelling.name: Cottage
dwelling.help: Food, showers, and somewhere to belong.

factory.name: Stone workshop
factory.help: Turns ore into blocks. Leaves pollution behind.

theatre.name: Clubhouse
theatre.help: Entertains a crowd and puts a spring in their step.

flowers.name: Flowers
flowers.help: Some things need no practical purpose.

tnt.name: Demolition charge
tnt.help: Place by the mountain. Tap to detonate.

cannon.name: Sky launcher
cannon.help: Healthy volunteers travel to a shared home in orbit. Tap to see their destination and arrivals.

inspect.name: Hand
inspect.help: Drag or use arrows to explore. Scroll, pinch or + / − to zoom. COLONY brings you home.

banana.name: Banana
banana.help: Tap the grass to drop a banana. Hungry creatures will find it.

cloth.name: Cloth
cloth.help: Tap a creature to wash them.

cricketball.name: Cricket ball
cricketball.help: Tap the grass to put down a cricket ball.

axe.name: Axe
axe.help: Tap a tree. Nearby creatures carry the logs to the bridge.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.help: Break rocks into ore, ore into blocks. Remove buildings or stumps.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.help: Drop a meteor inside the marked circle. Destroys trees and buildings, and kills creatures caught in the impact.

bug.name: Reclaimer
bug.help: Turns a creature into bones. The colony remembers this choice.

grabber.name: Carry
grabber.help: Pick up a material stack or remains, then tap clear ground to place it.

swarm.name: Reclaimer sweep
swarm.help: Reclaims an area. Creatures within it will be lost.

mop.name: Scrub brush
mop.help: Clean polluted ground and the creatures around it.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Flight record / The lights we left
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: Three suns once lit the windows of their garden cities. The spacecraft's first surviving photograph shows a door left open, waiting for someone who never reached the launch field.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Room for one more
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: Three little lives in the clearing. The spacecraft carried a way for each survivor to make more of their kind. A family can begin again, even here.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Flight record / The last launch
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: The launch computer recorded more goodbyes than seats. A keeper stayed on the ground to close the spacecraft's hatch. Its passenger log ends with a single instruction: keep them alive.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Something our paws can change
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: We have gathered timber. It is heavy, and it is useful. The first materials of this home did not have to come from the spacecraft.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: The shape of a good day
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: A meal, a wash, a bounce, a friend. Small routines hold us together while we learn how to make bigger plans.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Flight record / What the flare changed
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: The spacecraft's medic recorded a change in the survivors' DNA after the triple flare. They could endure the radiation, but no longer hold a plan in mind. They still reached for each other.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: A whole little chorus
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: There are twenty of us. Twenty different names, twenty places at the meal. We are beginning to need more than another helping hand: a way to think together.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Thank you for trusting our paws
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: You have given us permission to build our own settlement. We will need shared intelligence to choose our projects. When it is resting, we can still look after the little things.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: The beginning of a tomorrow
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: Our first independent project is finished. A thought became work, and work became something real. The flare took a great deal from us. Perhaps it did not take every possible future.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Flight record / The unfinished lullaby
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: The cabin recorder kept three notes of a lullaby. The rest is missing. When the Tripelkins chirp to one another, sometimes those same three notes seem to be looking for an ending.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Breakfast has another address
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: A second banana grove is here. More than one corner of the colony can grow breakfast now. We can plan homes around food instead of all crowding around one meal.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Room under the rain
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: Another rain shower is ready. A place to wash near where we live means less time walking across the whole settlement with muddy paws.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Two places to be silly
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: We have another bounce garden. There is something reassuring about building a place simply because it makes our friends happy.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: A bank we can come back from
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: The bridge is finished. The far bank is part of our world now. We still need paths, meals and washing places wherever new work takes us.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: A problem became a path
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: An obstructed route has been opened. Instead of asking everyone to try the same impossible journey, we made room for the next step.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Fifty names to keep
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: Fifty Tripelkins. The spacecraft's passenger number has become a neighborhood. Please keep noticing the little ones at the edges; a large family still has small needs.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Flight record / The long quiet
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: For years the spacecraft searched. It turned toward water, away from storms, and onward from worlds with nowhere to land. Its fuel log became shorter. Its instruction never changed.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: A door that opens inward
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: The first cottage is standing. On the old world, a light in a window meant that someone expected you back. We can give this place that meaning too.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Learning the weight of things
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: Our paws have worked stone from the ground. Some things take more than enthusiasm. They take a reachable workplace, enough materials, and a friend who knows the next step.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: The part after work
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: We have a clubhouse. The old cities had rooms for songs; this clearing can have one too. Surviving should leave a little space for being alive.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: A hundred small futures
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: A hundred Tripelkins are here. We cannot rebuild the home we lost by remembering it harder. We can build places where these lives will be safe tomorrow.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: Flight record / The landing decision
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: This clearing was not the spacecraft's best candidate. It was the last one within reach. The landing exhausted its long search. Everything that happens next belongs to the lives inside.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: A home with several centers
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: Our groves are spreading. A new neighborhood needs its own food, water and play, not just more space. That is how exploring becomes living somewhere.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: This time, a way back
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: Some of us have reached orbit. The first spacecraft left a home it could never return to. This journey can be different: a home above, with friends still waiting below.

game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.title: The fourth note
game.colony-letters.CHAPTERS.text: The flight record ends here. The colony does not. The missing part of the lullaby can be meals shared, paths opened, and little homes built together. A future does not have to sound like the past.

game.story-content.ARCHIVES.title: 01 / Three suns, one last spacecraft
game.story-content.ARCHIVES.text: A simultaneous flare from three suns destroyed the Tripelkins' home. In this fictional history, a change in their DNA preserved their bodies and instincts but cost them deliberate planning. Their spacecraft found this clearing. Care can keep them alive; shared intelligence can help their growing family build a future. Replay their journey in Game options.

game.story-content.ARCHIVES.title: 02 / Rooms and routines
game.story-content.ARCHIVES.text: A useful settlement separates paths, meals and rest. Its inhabitants reveal the design by living in it.

game.story-content.ARCHIVES.title: 03 / Two materials
game.story-content.ARCHIVES.text: A ledger can count the pieces of a bridge. It cannot make wood and a former companion mean the same thing.

game.story-content.ARCHIVES.title: 04 / What remains
game.story-content.ARCHIVES.text: Production creates a second product: the things nobody meant to make. The ground keeps that record.

game.story-content.ARCHIVES.title: 05 / A larger we
game.story-content.ARCHIVES.text: A population is a number only from far away. Departure changes the scale of care, not its existence.

game.story-content.ARCHIVES.title: 06 / Our settlement journal
game.story-content.ARCHIVES.text: The colony remembers actions and their consequences. Its reflection describes this playthrough, not the person outside it.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: A little life
game.story-content.BEATS.text: The spacecraft is quiet now. Your clearing smells of rain and growing things. Could this be somewhere we can stay?

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Something to share
game.story-content.BEATS.text: That banana was for us? We will remember the first gift.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: A new feeling
game.story-content.BEATS.text: The water carries yesterday away. We are still ourselves.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Another way to move
game.story-content.BEATS.text: It does not make food. It makes being here better.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: More than one
game.story-content.BEATS.text: There is another pair of paws beside us. The journey did not end with just one little life.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Small arrangements
game.story-content.BEATS.text: One of us can bathe while another eats. Could we have places of our own?

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Tomorrow grows here
game.story-content.BEATS.text: A banana can be a meal, or a promise of many meals.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Spring in our paws
game.story-content.BEATS.text: We found a favorite bouncing spot. There is room for a friend beside it.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: A map for our paws
game.story-content.BEATS.text: The survey beacon has marked the river. We have somewhere new to explore.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: What a bridge is made of
game.story-content.BEATS.text: Wood takes work. Bones were someone. The distance across is the same.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: A piece of the future
game.story-content.BEATS.text: We carried this together. A road begins with something small.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: The other bank
game.story-content.BEATS.text: The world became larger because we finished something.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Inside the stone
game.story-content.BEATS.text: There was a different kind of brightness hiding inside.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: A place to work
game.story-content.BEATS.text: Now the stone has a doorway. Work should have a way home, too.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Useful brightness
game.story-content.BEATS.text: We can turn what we find into what we need. What will it cost the air?

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Belonging
game.story-content.BEATS.text: A roof is more than an efficient arrangement of walls.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: A room for a song
game.story-content.BEATS.text: Let there be a place whose purpose is not more work.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: The boundary
game.story-content.BEATS.text: We know how to change small things. Must every boundary be changed?

game.story-content.BEATS.title: A very loud question
game.story-content.BEATS.text: The charge is ready. You still choose whether to use it.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Still standing
game.story-content.BEATS.text: The mountain did not answer. Something behind it did.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Another voice
game.story-content.BEATS.text: The survey beacon shows a route to orbit. We can keep a home here, too.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: Leaving the clearing
game.story-content.BEATS.text: A few of us are above the clouds. We still count them as us.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: A home above
game.story-content.BEATS.text: Twelve journeys connected our two homes. There is one more choice to make together.

game.story-content.BEATS.title: The hand in the sky
game.story-content.BEATS.text: The world has changed. Bring us to the opening, one at a time.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: A little help with muddy fur
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: Could we have another place to wash?

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: A day needs more than work
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: Some of us have forgotten how to play.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: One place is empty
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: There is a place beside us that is empty now.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: Please look before you strike
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: The hand meant something else. Someone was beneath it.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: A name we will keep
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: We remember who became the bridge.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: Timber beneath our feet
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: This crossing was made without taking one of us.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: What this crossing carries
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: The crossing carries more than our footsteps.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: The air by the workshop
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: The air near the works makes us heavy.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: Room to breathe
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: Someone noticed what the work left behind.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: A little more room for work
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: More work fits here. Do we also have more time to live?

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: Our next step needs a path
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: We cannot finish that journey. Could you clear a way?

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: A familiar face
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: Two of us have made a small habit of meeting.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: That name belongs to me
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: A sound can mean one particular life.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: We remembered what you asked
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: You asked, and we finished. That belongs in our memory.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: A gentler pace
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: We can wait. There are still small lives to care for.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: Two homes to care for
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: They are far away. The clearing still needs you.

game.story-content.INCIDENTS.title: We heard your answer
game.story-content.INCIDENTS.text: You said no. We will not keep asking.

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: Does looking after us change what you want from us?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: When a task ends, who chooses the next one?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: If you call us by a name, do you see us differently?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: Is a faster way across always a better way?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: If a place is useful, can it still be a place of mourning?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: Is there a number at which one voice becomes hard to hear?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: Can something matter without making anything else?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: Who owns the things work leaves behind?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: If we can begin again, did the first beginning happen?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: Could you help us do something you would not have chosen?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: If we leave the ground, will you still look for us?

game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.title: A small question
game.story-content.PHILOSOPHY.text: What do you hope we will remember about the hand in the sky?
